demo.notice: Fictional workspace for this browser. Do not enter real data. Access expires after 24 hours of inactivity. An hourly check deletes the workspace, its data and audit, usually in the next hour. Service or quota limits can delay deletion. Cleanup removes live records; provider recovery history may retain them for up to 6 hours. We do not export visitor backups.
demo.auditNotice: Last 100 redacted events in your workspace only. No patient details or passwords are shown.
demo.shortNotice: Fictional data only. Do not enter real information. Access expires after 24 hours idle.

demo.capacity: The demo is at capacity. Try again later. Existing visitor workspaces will not be deleted to make room.
demo.startWaiting: Starting your fictional workspace. Free hosting may need time to wake after inactivity. Keep this page open. We will not send another request automatically. A timeout stops waiting here, not work already running on the server.
demo.startUnknown: Starting the workspace may have completed, but we did not receive confirmation or a session. Wait one minute, then press Start again yourself. We cannot recover a session whose reply was lost. An unused workspace expires after 24 hours of inactivity, not immediately.
